description: Full-text substring search across all SEC filing exhibit content. Returns matching snippets with context around each match. Powerful for finding specific clauses like "change of control", "anti-dilution", "right of first refusal", or any specific language across filings. Optionally filter by company (CIK), filing, accession number, or form type.

accessionNumber.description: Filter to a specific filing by SEC accession number

cik.description: Filter to a specific company by CIK number

filingId.description: Filter to a specific filing by internal ID

pattern.description: Search pattern (minimum 2 characters). Substring match, case-insensitive.

snippetLength.description: Characters of context around each match (default: 200)

name: search_filing_text
title: Search Filing Text
